hook: Firecrackers sent *67* people in Hyderabad to hospital with eye injuries
hook_b: Firecrackers sent *67* people in Hyderabad to hospital with eye injuries
tldr: By Monday morning at least 67 people had sought treatment for cracker-related eye injuries at Sarojini Devi, Gandhi and Osmania hospitals (Siasat).

beats.what: At least 67 people, including children, were treated for firecracker eye injuries at Sarojini Devi Eye Hospital (Mehdipatnam), Gandhi Hospital and Osmania General Hospital, per Siasat figures till Monday morning.
beats.why: Injuries came from a range of fireworks, and bystanders made up many of the cases, The Hindu reports.
beats.care: Most patients were treated without surgery. Eight children need surgery (The Hindu). One patient reportedly lost vision in the right eye (Telangana Today).

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Outlets report different counts because they covered different hospitals and times. Telangana Today: about 35 at Sarojini Devi, six admitted, including four children. Deccan Chronicle: 48 at Sarojini Devi. NewsBytes: 60 at Sarojini Devi. Siasat: 67 across Sarojini Devi, Gandhi and Osmania, till Monday morning.

cards.q: After this, what's your cracker plan next Diwali?
Which hospital took most of Hyderabad's Diwali eye cases?
cards.why: The state-run eye hospital in Mehdipatnam treated most cases.

viz.l: Patients at Sarojini Devi who were children
viz.verdict: Children were nearly half the cases (The Hindu)
